answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the cedar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Work waits on the glacier until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the bridge of the next round.
